question: does the due-west cross line 10010 share ground with the N-S lines at across-track positions that separate their individual across-track coefficients?

inputs.role: raw 2008 gen1 LAZ tile containing the cross line 10010 and N-S lines 135-138, vendor classification

params.name: block_m
params.why: the 50 m cluster-robust block size used by swath_across_track_test.py

params.name: open_vegfrac
params.why: cover < 0.05 is the 'open' stratum boundary of swath_across_track_test.py; here it is the per-cell fraction of returns the VENDOR classified 5, the only cover proxy available in this tile (no gen2, no PyForestScan cover)

params.name: chunk
params.why: points per streamed read, a memory ceiling only; it changes no result because the per-cell reduction is done after the whole tile is assembled

columns.kind: N-S/N-S = both lines fly the boustrophedon; CROSS = one is the due-west line
columns.cells: 5 m cells covered by BOTH lines with >= 3 returns each
columns.area_ha: area of those shared cells, hectares
columns.tanA_lo: minimum per-cell mean tan(scan angle) of the lower-numbered line
columns.tanB_lo: minimum per-cell mean tan(scan angle) of the higher-numbered line
columns.corr_AB: Pearson correlation of the two lines' per-cell tan(scan angle)
columns.sd_sum: standard deviation of tanA+tanB over the shared cells
columns.sd_dif: standard deviation of tanA-tanB over the shared cells
columns.se_ratio: SE(q)/SE(p) from the design matrix [1, tanA-tanB, tanA+tanB]: how many times worse the ANTISYMMETRIC coefficient is determined than the symmetric one. 1 = the pair separates the two lines
columns.cond: condition number of that design matrix, column-standardised
columns.count: returns of the line carrying that classification in the tile
columns.psid: point_source_id, i.e. the flight line, dimensionless integer
columns.n_ret: returns of that line in the tile after the (5,6,9) exclusion
columns.frac2: fraction of that line's returns classified 2 (vendor bare earth)
columns.stratum: all = every shared cell; open = cells whose vendor class-5 return fraction is below open_vegfrac
columns.k_mm: fitted intercept at tanA=tanB=0, mm; positive = line A reads above line B
columns.p: fitted coefficient on tanA-tanB = (c_A+c_B)/2, mm per unit tangent
columns.p_se: cluster-robust standard error of p, mm per unit tangent
columns.q: fitted coefficient on tanA+tanB = (c_A-c_B)/2, mm per unit tangent: the combination a N-S overlap CANNOT see
columns.q_se: cluster-robust standard error of q, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_A: p+q, the lower-numbered line's own across-track coefficient, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_A_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_A, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_B: p-q, the higher-numbered line's own across-track coefficient, mm per unit tangent
columns.c_B_se: cluster-robust standard error of c_B, mm per unit tangent

headline: cross-line 10010 overlap geometry against the N-S lines
